compiled_state.title: Delete .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml + verify ci.yml is sole PR-side LLM-review consumer
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml deleted. Pre-deletion verification: diff job list against ci.yml; migrate any unique configuration.
- DD2: ci.yml's llm-review job remains the sole PR-side consumer of ci-llm-review-runner.sh.
- DD3: required-checks.txt continues to list llm-review (unchanged).
- DD6: PRs in flight when this lands lose Per-Story LLM Review on next push; llm-review still gates merge — no manual intervention.

## File Impact
| File | Action | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml | remove | (tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh from Task A) |
| .github/required-checks.txt | (unchanged — verify) | self |

## Implementation Notes
1. **Pre-deletion verification step**: diff the job list between per-branch-review.yml and ci.yml. Confirmed today (in this session) that the 8 non-llm-review jobs in per-branch-review.yml (actionlint, shellcheck, lint-python, test-hooks, test-scripts, validate-required-checks, mirror-tracker-defenses, review) all have equivalents in ci.yml (with mirror-tracker-defenses → mirror-defenses-to-pr the only name difference). Confirm one more time before deletion by re-running the diff.
2. If any unique job configuration is found (different timeout, env, condition), migrate it to ci.yml BEFORE deletion.
3. Delete .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml.
4. Verify required-checks.txt still has llm-review (line 28). No changes expected.
5. Run Task A's behavioral test — should PASS after deletion.

## TDD Requirement
Task A's behavioral test (test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh) must PASS after this task lands (count of llm-review-class jobs for a SHA = exactly 1). Deletion of the workflow file is the implementation; the test from Task A validates.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] per-branch-review.yml does NOT exist
  Verify: ! test -f .github/workflows/per-branch-review.yml
- [ ] ci.yml's llm-review job still exists
  Verify: grep -q '^  llm-review:' .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] required-checks.txt still lists llm-review unchanged
  Verify: grep -q '^llm-review$' .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] ci.yml is schema-valid (declarative-artifact rule)
  Verify: command -v actionlint && actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml || python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"
- [ ] Task A's behavioral test now PASSES (single-run invariant satisfied)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-single-llm-review-per-sha.sh
- [ ] .test-index RED marker for test_single_llm_review_per_sha is REMOVED (test now GREEN)
  Verify: ! grep -q '\[test_single_llm_review_per_sha\]' .test-index
